outside_window.finding: The IPO underwriting agreement locks up the company and its directors, officers and securityholders for 180 days after the prospectus, about 2026-12-14. Cornerstone investors' shares (up to $10m) are NOT locked up. Expiry is a dated supply release. The flip side is that the company lock-up also blocks a primary offering tonight unless the underwriters waive it, and any officer or director waiver has to be announced 2 business days ahead.
Short interest rose 31.8% into the 09-15 settlement. The 09-30 settlement, which would show whether Iceberg's position and followers added or covered, publishes around 2026-10-09.
The Q3 10-Q is due. The only date is Zacks's cadence estimate of 2026-11-02, which the company has not announced, so it is not evidence of a date.
